identification: E. Ingraham Co., Bristol, Conn. USA black-painted wooden (faux slate) 8-day striking mantel clock with three faux-marble columns each side, faux marble plinths, cast brass-finish feet and side handles, Roman dial with gilt centre. Red paper label on base. No pendulum, key not mentioned. H28 W37 cm. About 1890-1910.
